title: Best-effort MIME parsing with warnings Vec is the right API contract
description: parse() returns Err only for empty input and no-headers-at-all; all other malformed input returns Ok with warnings populated. This matches real email: the vast majority of messages in the wild have at least one deviation from RFC 5322 that a strict parser would reject. A future contributor suggesting 'return Err for any RFC violation' would render the crate useless for processing real-world email inboxes. The CLAUDE.md documents this invariant explicitly.
close_reason: Design decision documented; no code change needed
